thresholds.meaning: (relative, absolute): a change is flagged when it exceeds both

highlights.title: iroh 1.4.1 -> 1.5.0 (fork with relay recovery fixes): nothing measurable changed.
highlights.detail: Same outcome in every scenario whose environment did not change, 0 connections lost, QUIC counters in 93/93; lab RTT 40.4 / 80.6 ms, throughput ~123 / ~35 Mbps, connect/hole-punching and bind times identical, also with the lab's relay on 1.5.0; real-world numbers within the route clusters; the 1.4.1 real relay carried the 1.5.0 clients without drops. Verdicts 110 right / 1 misleading / 0 wrong runs, as in campaigns 3 and 4.

highlights.title: Three outcome changes (relay -> direct) are this machine's firewall:
highlights.detail: rw-symmetric-to-ufw, rw-ufw-to-easy and rw-ufw-to-symmetric go direct, and rw-easy-to-ufw is direct from the first packet, because the reinstalled build machine has no ufw; final paths 60 direct / 33 relay (was 51 / 42). With ufw's filtering emulated on the same build (debug/ufw-emul, 12 runs) campaign 4's outcomes come back exactly.

highlights.title: Faster binds and no slow downloads on this machine:
highlights.detail: load < 0.4 (campaign 4: 24-49 from other sessions): startup-hetzner binds 667 -> 588 ms, relay-single 584 -> 507 ms; no slow Hetzner -> lab download (campaign 4: 3). The regression flag on rw-open-to-easy RTT (33.8 -> 37.3 ms) is the route cluster.

highlights.title: New: ERROR/WARN log lines at endpoint shutdown (iroh fork),
highlights.detail: in 41 % of process exits (84 of 204; 'relay_recv_channel closed', 'All transports failed to receive'), only during close, no functional effect. Local repro: 0/30 with iroh 1.4.1 and with upstream main, 7/30 with the fork rev: from its relay-recovery commit (relay actors end before the QUIC endpoint stops polling). To fix in the fork/upstream PR.

highlights.title: Lossy link:
highlights.detail: packet_loss 9/13 and relay_compare ok 13/13 as in campaign 4; concurrency measured 13/13, 1 restart (was 2), cut-off requests now cancelled on the wire (late requests at the listener: 2/13 runs, <= 0.1 s; campaign 4: 7/13, up to 3.9 s); one upload whose count came 0.9 s after the bench stopped waiting (exit 5, debug run): bench bug, fixed in cda49ae.
